reply: I'd push back on "nothing there." We've spent this conversation and you've named a temper, a closed exam window, a guitar in its case, a wife who stopped asking — that's not an empty head. That's a lot of feeling that never got words. Maybe the fear isn't that she'd see nothing, but that she'd see how much, and you'd have to feel it too. What do you think she'd actually do if you said "I don't know"?
